project_type: Next.js 15 / React 19 / TypeScript monorepo, App Router, Supabase auth
build_system: Next.js 15 with `next build`; standalone output mode; no custom webpack config; uses `--legacy-peer-deps` for any new deps due to React 19 peer constraints
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner via `node --test tests/trading-safety.test.cjs`; no Jest/Vitest
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from d:\tradebridge — must exit 0. 2. Run `npm run build` from d:\tradebridge — must exit 0 and show /bots in route list.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell shell. Use `;` not `&&` for command chaining in PowerShell. npm commands must be run from d:\tradebridge. Blockly MUST be loaded with `next/dynamic` + `{ ssr: false }` — it calls `document` at import time. All new component files must include `"use client"` directive.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow patterns in existing components. Use CSS Modules only (no Tailwind). No forms (use controlled React state + buttons). Mirror WebSocket pattern from useDemoTrading.ts.
key_patterns: 1. CSS Modules with variables from TradingWorkspace.module.css (--page, --panel, --surface, --ink, --muted, --line, --border, --teal, --teal-soft, --red, --amber). 2. WorkspacePage type and PRIMARY_NAV in TradingWorkspace.tsx. 3. WebSocket hook pattern: socketRef + sequenceRef + nextId() + cancelled flag + localStorage pending-marker. 4. useEffect cleanup returns. 5. `"use client"` on all interactive components. 6. No SSR for browser-only deps: use next/dynamic with ssr:false.
directory_structure: src/app/(workspace)/[section]/page.tsx — route validation (SECTIONS array already includes 'bots'); src/components/trading/ — all existing trading components; src/lib/bots/ — strategy engine (strategy-engine.mjs + .d.mts); src/components/bots/ — NEW directory for all bot components
